Package io.github.lord_of_nothing.grid

Class GridInputHandler

java.lang.Object
com.badlogic.gdx.InputAdapter
io.github.lord_of_nothing.grid.GridInputHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.badlogic.gdx.InputProcessor
public class GridInputHandler extends com.badlogic.gdx.InputAdapter
Handles mouse input for UI clicks, sidebar selection, and building placement.

      public GridInputHandler(com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.OrthographicCamera camera, Grid grid, GameWindow window, Sidebar sidebar, ResourceStateMutator resources, EventBus eventBus, TileInspectorBar tileInspectorBar, EventLog eventLog, AudioManager audioManager)
      Creates the input handler and subscribes to relevant flow/UI events.
      Parameters:
      camera - world camera used for unprojecting screen coordinates
      grid - grid model
      sidebar - sidebar model used for template selection
      resources - resource state mutator used for cost checks
      eventBus - event bus used to track UI creation and pause state
      tileInspectorBar - state model used for displaying and inspecting tile buildings
